Incoterms 2020 là bộ Điều kiện Thương mạ.zh: 2020年国际贸易术语解释通则是国际商会为适应实际情况而编制并修改的2020年国际贸易资格认证部门. 《国际贸易术语解释通则》包括国际贸易中包含的规则,其中关联方的责任包括卖方和买方在交货方过程中的责任。 这些条件不是强制性的,只是对采购合同具有约束力。

That means the salesmen haven't paid all the transportation fees, taxes, the risks that the buyers have to take on these taxes.
Nhắc đến điều kiện giao hàng DDU – Deliv.zh: 提到DDU交付的条件 — — Delife Doy Unpended,这是2020年《国际贸易术语解释通则》中的标准之一,这意味着没有交付税款。 这意味着销售商没有支付所有的运输费,税收,买家必须承担的风险来承担这些税收.

Sử dụng quy định DDU giúp cho quá trình.en: Using the DDU regulation helps to better track the shipment, determining the responsibility clearly to avoid unnecessary contradictions. This condition is consistent with domestic traffic goods. The significant benefit of this rule is to reduce costs for both the purchase party and the sales side.
Sử dụng quy định DDU giúp cho quá trình.zh: 利用DDU条例有助于更好地跟踪货运,明确确定责任以避免不必要的矛盾。 这一条件与国内交通货物一致. 这一规则的重大好处是减少了购买方和销售方的成本。

Theo những nội dung được thể hiện trong.en: According to the content expressed in the DDU delivery conditions, we can also enhance the benefits that this regulation provides for the trading, commercial activity. In it, the dealer would be the party responsible for the risks during the delivery of the cargo to the agreed location in the contract. The seller is responsible for completing the information, importing, and cost of receiving the goods to the buyer. The buyer will take responsibility for the rest.
Theo những nội dung được thể hiện trong.zh: 根据DDU交货条件中表述的内容,我们也能够增加该条例为贸易、商业活动提供的好处。 其中,经销商对将货物交付至合同约定地点期间的风险负有责任。 卖方负责填写信息、进口和接收货物给买方的费用。 其余部分由买方负责。
